# Bounded five-loop coordinate pilot — 2026-09-30

Both regenerated libraries pass independent **scoped cold-All closure** for the
same 784 physical input points. The reindexed library uses fewer native
inspections, but is slower to generate and has larger coefficient data. Both
durable-artifact certification attempts fail at the existing lowering resource
limit. Neither is a qualified replacement for the production 67-owner library.

## Exact scope and identity

Evidence root: `TMP/codex-true-deepening.l9fXPO/five-pivot/`.
The original `proposal.json`, `plan.json`, `walk-plan.json` and native command
bytes were preserved. `resource-amendment.json` changes resources only.
Both arms use the same real campaign-profile executable
`TMP/codex-parallel-campaign.oiPK29/candidate-bin/rustred-3428b519`, SHA256
`321b02b166c61dae927a220b7b8007b4659fef009d2b5b003084830b0f43eca3`, source
`3428b5191f161c8750d5f3397bd61e46792e765c`. No Rust rebuild or new A strategy
API is used by this experiment.

The physical seven-line root is `101101100101000`: 128 support subsets,
14 nonzero literal supports in four symmetry classes. Each arm freshly generates
its full downset with sparse exact arithmetic, numerical depth 2 and finite-case
Search, then selects all 14 freshly generated literal owner payloads and 14 identity
routes. No historical owner payload is reused. The one explicitly Required query
is a strict bounded subset of the original nested D ≥ 9 required cell: A ≤ 10, R ≤ 1,
D = A − R ≥ 9, plus the exact coordinate caps in the proposal; 784 integer points.
Its inherited identifier contains `a22-r13`, but those are **not** this probe's
actual bounds. Descendants are not clipped to the entry box.

Reindexing uses new-slot → old-slot
`[0,1,3,5,6,8,9,13,14,2,4,7,10,11,12]`, with the inverse runtime permutation
preserving physical final coordinate ties. Query geometry and denominator
expressions were checked under this exact mapping; roles and scalar bounds
match. The fourteen copied payload hashes match each new checkpoint receipt.
The motivating eleven-line shared interface cannot occur inside this seven-line
root: this tests heuristic transfer, not direct evidence about that interface,
all 67 owners, all 183 queries, or a best five-loop ordering. This is also distinct
from the separately registered runtime source-row strategy portfolio P1.

## Execution and outcomes

One absolute 1800 s clock started at 02:48:16.849 UTC, before runtime preparation.
All eight owned native groups had independently drained by 604.6 s; the P2 lock
was independently acquired/released. Each phase retained its registered cap.
Root held global heavy; P2 used W16 / CPUs 64–79 and `pilot-p2.lock`, while D1
could run concurrently on 32–47. All guards retained 250 GiB start / 150 GiB live
host headroom. LC2 CPUs 128–227 and its checkpoint were untouched.
These are **concurrent exploratory timings**, not isolated speed qualification.
The native walks were too short for the ten-second contention sampler to record
a sample, so no measured foreign-CPU correction is available.

## Certification, cached status, and independent closure

Both certification attempts returned exit 8 from durable rule lowering:
`combined domain bound endpoint cells budget exceeded: requested 8220, limit 8192`.
Natural failed at retained rule 157 / 228; reindexed at 137 / 315 in different sectors.
Both raw error receipts remain under `runs/*/certification-guard/`; no certified
artifact or successful artifact-cold receipt exists, and no limit was enlarged.

In the pinned source, `SourcePortAudit::retain_program_with_observer` checks all
sectors' original-source replay/descent before `CheckedProgram::install_with_observer`
lowers retained rules. Reaching this later lowering error therefore implies the
retention checks completed, **by source-path inference**. It is not a returned
standalone successful replay report, and whole-artifact certification did not pass.
No claim is made that the failure is merely insufficient unrestricted coverage.

Both native walks actually returned exit 4/`incomplete`: their cached engine
closure count was still 0. The natural snapshot revision was 461 versus graph 18498;
the cold verifier is independent of these cached flags. Raw
`runs/{natural,pinch-interface}/walk/cold.json` each reports `PASS`, all-roots,
All reinspection complete (2644 / 2644 and 1792 / 1792), exact request/owner bindings,
one admitted/independently verified Required root, no frontiers, uncovered events,
violations or exact/brute disagreements. It independently re-derives closure for
all 2919 and 2115 sealed nodes, including 586 and 484 nodes on cycles, respectively.
Do not rewrite the native exits as exit 0 or equate this coinductive dependency
closure with original-IBP replay, descent, termination, or a minimal master basis.

Inputs and conservation receipts: `inputs/*/{selection.json,input-receipt.json}`;
phase argv, guards, CPU/memory and raw outputs: `runs/*/`; pinned original clock
and resource amendment: `clock.json` and `resource-amendment.json`. No follow-up
native experiment is authorized by these results alone.
